description: Find DeFi yield pools across 400+ protocols and 100+ chains (DefiLlama data): APY split into base and reward, 30-day mean APY, 7-day APY change, TVL, stablecoin flag, impermanent-loss risk. Filter by chain (e.g. 'Base', 'Ethereum'), project (e.g. 'aave'), token symbol (e.g. 'USDC'), stablecoin_only, min_tvl_usd (default 1,000,000); sort by 'apy' (default) or 'tvl'. Outliers (flagged by DefiLlama or above 500% APY) are excluded unless include_outliers is true. Price: $0.0055 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon or Arbitrum). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"chain":"Base","symbol":"USDC","stablecoin_only":true,"limit":5}.

chain.description: Chain name as on DefiLlama, e.g. Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Solana

project.description: Protocol slug or part of it, e.g. aave, morpho, aerodrome

symbol.description: Token symbol contained in the pool, e.g. USDC, ETH

name: defi_yields
title: DeFi Yields
